en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a church with a tall clock tower and spire beside a landscaped square with a pond and small fountain in the foreground. A turreted corner building stands on the left, trees and paths encircle the water, and a few people walk along the paths. Printed German text appears at the top of the image indicating the location as Coswig in Saxony and the Anlagen (gardens/grounds) at Wettin Square.
